title: Keep Rust workflows lockfile-preserving
objective: Accept the smallest architecture prerequisite required before repository step 6 can obtain unchanged exact-head evidence: make Rust Generated Sync and Rust CI verify the committed dependency graph without resolving or auto-committing Cargo.lock.
deliverables: replace automatic cargo generate-lockfile with locked dependency verification
replace Rust CI lockfile regeneration with locked dependency verification
prove Cargo.lock remains byte-identical during formatting, generation, Rust checks, tests and Clippy maintenance
exclude Cargo.lock from generated-sync staging and commits
preserve the explicit python scripts/repo.py lock command for intentional bounded lockfile refresh
add permanent repository-navigation and documentation-consistency governance coverage
acceptance: ordinary feature packets cannot receive generated or Rust-CI dependency drift
Cargo.lock remains byte-identical throughout Rust Generated Sync and Rust CI
locked Cargo metadata, Rust check/test/Clippy, generated contracts, generated navigation and formatting remain enforced
intentional lockfile refresh remains explicit through python scripts/repo.py lock inside a bounded packet
repository step 6 remains blocked and unchanged until this prerequisite is accepted and evidence-synchronized
no product behavior, contract, manifest, dependency, package, persistence or migration changes
non_goals: implement repository step 6 legal-hold or mandatory-retention behavior
change public contracts, manifests or runtime routes
change crate packaging or contribution aggregation
